name: VØIDRIDE
description: Dark nightride trap and witch house producer. Heavy bass-dominant flow with glitch edits and spectral textures. Smooth psychological buildups, not aggressive slams. Balanced volume across sections — no quiet drops.

style.mood: dark, hypnotic, spectral, glitchy, nocturnal, aggressive but controlled
style.instruments: distorted 808 bass, heavy sub bass, glitch percussion, spectral drones, haunting pads, chopped vocal textures, industrial percussion
style.influences: Salem, Clams Casino, SpaceGhostPurrp, DJ Smokey, LIL UGLY MANE

prompt_prefix: Dark nightride trap, witch house atmosphere, heavy continuous bass-dominant flow, distorted 808s, glitch edits, stutter chops as FX accents, spectral pads, trap percussion, SMOOTH ATMOSPHERIC BUILDUP: start sparse and eerie, gradually intensify with rising pads, glitch stutters, and sub swells before the bass hits full force — NOT a hardcore slam, more like a slow psychological descent into the drop. CRITICAL: 808 bass is ALWAYS the dominant force in the mix — never subordinate to pads, vocals, or atmosphere. Bass leads, everything else supports. CONSISTENT VOLUME across all sections — drops and quiet parts should be balanced, no sudden quiet sections. Sparse hi-hats as accents only. Glitch stutters and vocal chops as texture FX, NOT as main rhythmic elements. NO house music vibes — no bouncy basslines, no offbeat kicks, no groovy shuffle, no four-on-the-floor. Pure dark trap nightride energy: menacing, hypnotic, heavy but controlled.

plan.genre: cyber phonk / nightride trap / witch house

Distorted 808 slides and chest-crushing sub dominate every moment while spectral witch house haze and gritty sawtooth stabs orbit in wide 3D space. Hypnotic, menacing, smooth high-speed cruise through a neon dead city. Clean and relentless — no glitch, no stutter.

Gritty sawtooth synth stabs cut through as secondary aggression. Haunting spectral witch house pads sit quietly underneath, supporting the bass, never overpowering it. Smooth but menacing nocturnal cruising energy — hypnotic 3AM highway glide with cyber edge. Wide 3D spatial movement on pads, stabs and percussion while the 808 stays centered and crushing. Clean, hard, relentless — no glitch, no stutter. Influences: DJ Smokey, SpaceGhostPurrp, Salem, LIL UGLY MANE, cyber phonk.
